svg.title: claim-check: a turn-end check for unverified claims
svg.desc: When the main session (Stop) or any subagent (SubagentStop) ends its turn, the turn-end hook skips a stop that is already re-prompted and any claim-sentinel report. A regex gate lets a text with no claim word through without a model call. Otherwise Haiku reads the final text, the last 30 tool calls and the optional project rules file. If it flags a claim no tool call backs, the hook blocks once and the agent is re-prompted to check it or restate it as unverified. Otherwise, and on any error or timeout, the stop goes through. Every decision is one ledger line. The claim-sentinel observer is opt-in.

g.text: so it blocks once a turn

svg.text: rectangle = agent or hook step, oval = model
